findings.message: <polyline> is hidden with stroke-dasharray 1 and stroke-dashoffset 1 on pathLength 1, but its round cap can still paint a dot at the end of the path (Chrome rounds the zero-length dash differently per curve).
findings.fixHint: Make the gap longer than the path (stroke-dasharray "1 1.2" with stroke-dashoffset 1.1), or keep the element visibility:hidden until its draw tween starts.
